reels.title: M33 GITARA
reels.yt_title: Watching guitar tutorials isn't learning guitar #Shorts
reels.caption:
Watching tutorials isn't learning. 🎸

Same guitar, two plans. One plays 10 minutes a day. One saves another tutorial. Day 30, sore fingers. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 40 songs vs 912 saved videos.

Watching isn't learning. Playing is.

Send this to someone with a dusty guitar.

#guitar #learning #habits #discipline #motivation

reels.title: M34 ZENG
reels.caption:
Call your parents. Not "talk soon." 📞

Same parents, two choices. One calls home every other day. One texts "talk soon!" and lets it ring. Day 30, a busy day. Next day, he calls back. A year later: 182 calls vs 122 missed.

Same parents. Different year.

Send this to someone who should call home.

#family #parents #callyourmom #relationships #life
